title: i18n(platform-objects): ship the platform objects, Setup, Studio and Account in Brazilian Portuguese
body:

Body: seat final 速读 · 2026-11-08T08:25Z

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X5xwArPxERFNdAjYY2nKcc9)_

Part of #30512
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：给 `@objectstack/platform-objects` 加上巴西葡萄牙语（pt-BR）：平台对象、Studio 的元数据表单、Setup/Studio/Account 导航、系统概览仪表板和用户/组织记录页的内嵌文字，做法与已合并的 fr（#31233）逐文件一致。
- 为什么改：pt-BR 是 #30512 要补的第四个语言；语言设为 pt-BR 的用户此前在主页动态里读到葡语句子夹着英文字段名（`Banned`、`Ban Reason`）。
- 风险与回滚：只新增 pt-BR 文件、注册行和测试里的语言列表，不改任何已有语言的文字（其余 21 个生成文件字节不变）；新文字同样走 source-hash 回退。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/pt-BR.ts`（导航钉住项），`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/activity-summary-pt-br-sys-user-labels.test.ts`（新守护测试），`pt-BR.metadata-forms.generated.ts` 里 `widgets.layout` 带上父名的译法（`Layout do widget`）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/plugins/plugin-audit && npx vitest run src/activity-summary-pt-br-sys-user-labels.test.ts`，预期 3 个测试通过，句子为「Atualizou Usuário "Carl Edited": Banido e Motivo do banimento」。
- 需要你做的：请 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 批准本 PR。席位契约复审 ACCEPT 在评论 6719237445，`Head-sha: 1d1308b5c14e578fdc7a70ed1a0ad4529fab5827`。PR 含生成文件，超过 3000 行，需人工批准。批准后由席位重合 main、重跑导航 i18n 检查，然后落地。

## What changes
- New `pt-BR` bundles in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations`: `pt-BR.objects.generated.ts` (1697 leaves), `pt-BR.metadata-forms.generated.ts` (1263 leaves), their provenance table `pt-BR.source-hashes.generated.ts` (88 deliberate byte copies of `en`, listed under Acceptance notes), the hand-authored `pt-BR.ts` (141 leaves) and `pt-BR.source-hashes.ts` recording the `en` digest of every hand leaf.
- Registration: the extract config's `--locales` docstring and `translations:` baseline, `setup.translation.ts`, the `apps` barrel, and `metadata-translations/index.ts`.
- Inline maps: 36 in `sys-user.page.ts`, 6 in `sys-organization.page.ts`, and the System Overview null label in `system.datasets.ts` (`Sistema`).
- Wording pins, as #31233 lists them: `nav_account_approvals` reads as plugin-approvals' `my_pending` label (`Minhas aprovações pendentes`), `nav_assignment_rules` as `sys_assignment_rule`'s plural label (`Regras de atribuição`), each `nav_settings_*` (including `nav_settings_access_policy`, `Política de acesso`) as its service-settings hub title, `nav_settings_hub` as the console's `backToHub` (`Todas as configurações`), and the four #30935 keys: `grp_account_ai_assistant` = `Assistente de IA`; both `nav_connect_agent` entries and `pages.connect_agent.label` = `Conectar um assistente de IA`.
- Changeset `.changeset/30512-platform-objects-pt-br.md` (patch).

## Tests
- `pt-BR` added beside `fr` to the locale lists of every test #31233 widened (vocabulary, nav parity, dead-key tombstone, source-hash, bu-rename, copy tests, record-page tabs, plugin translation loads), plus plugin-approvals `approval-status-vocabulary`, plugin-security `people-org-assignment-nav-contribution` and service-settings `setup-nav-hub-parity`. No test listing the platform locales was added on main since #31233. The cli `platform-page-i18n-parity` LOCALE_KEY shape already accepts `pt-BR`.
- New `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/activity-summary-pt-br-sys-user-labels.test.ts`, the `pt-BR` twin of the #28107 `fr` test: an i18n service holding what a booted kernel holds composes a `sys_user` update summary for a reader whose locale is `pt-BR`, and gets `Atualizou Usuário "Carl Edited": Banido e Motivo do banimento`; a tracked change names `Motivo do banimento`. Ablation: with the platform `pt-BR` bundle left out of the service, two cases fail with `Atualizou User "Carl Edited": Banned e Ban Reason` and `Ban Reason: spam → abuse`, the English labels inside Portuguese glue; restored, 3 of 3 pass.

## Acceptance notes
- Every leaf is translated. The 88 byte copies of `en` the extract records are words Brazilian Portuguese uses as they are (`Status` ×8, `Namespace` ×6, `Token` ×3, `Kanban`, `Gantt`, `Layout`, `Widget`, `Widgets`, `Hook`, `Handler`, `Patch`, `Tags`, `Avatar`, `Slug`, `Global`, `Manual`, `App`, `Web`, `Feeds`, `Shards`), identifiers and header names (`ID` ×24, `API` ×2, `JWKS`, `JWKS URI`, `Message-ID`, `Reply-To` ×2, `Cc`, `snake_case`, the SAML `urn:…:emailAddress` NameID format, the `openid email profile` / `email` / `name` defaults), lowercase option values that are identifiers (`marketing`, `workflow`, `cron`, `dlq`, `manual`, `api`, `web`), and the five JSON examples kept verbatim as every locale keeps them.
- Where a catalog test refuses an `en` echo (`repeater-row-properties` on `dashboard:widgets.layout`), the leaf names its parent instead (`Layout do widget`), as `fr` and `es-ES` do.
- Vocabulary follows `ui/packages/i18n` `pt-BR`: straight quotes, `Excluir`, `Salvar`, `Painel`, `Visualização`, `Função`, `Proprietário`, `Locatário`; Brazilian forms throughout (`você`, `arquivo`, `usuário`, `equipe`). The job position is `Cargo`; the add-record button's `Position` is `Posição` (the place). Adjectives agree with the noun they qualify (`Todos`/`Todas`, `Ativos`/`Ativas`, `Revogada`, `Desativados`, …).
- Business units are `Unidades de negócios`; no `sys_business_unit*` label says `Departamento` (`bu-rename-consistency`).
- `pages.connect_agent.subtitle` is translated from the current `en` text, so its digest in `pt-BR.source-hashes.ts` is current. The `fr` table records the digest of the previous `en` subtitle, so `fr` readers get the `en` subtitle through the fallback today; that is existing `fr` behaviour, left alone here.

## Verification
- `os i18n extract packages/platform-objects/scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts --locales=zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES,zh-Hant,ar,fr,pt-BR --fill=default --source-hashes --out=packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations`: regenerates the `pt-BR` bundles byte-identical and leaves the 21 other generated files unchanged (sha256 over all 23, before and after), both before and after the merge of `origin/main`. `check-i18n-bundles --filter=platform-objects`: in sync (23 bundles).
- `vitest run` in platform-objects: 120 files, 1796 tests passed. plugin-approvals `approval-status-vocabulary` (6), plugin-security `people-org-assignment-nav-contribution` (5), service-settings `setup-nav-hub-parity` (17), cli `platform-page-i18n-parity` (27) and the new plugin-audit test (3) passed.
- platform-objects `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --ran` at 1d1308b5 (after the second merge of `origin/main`): 68 derived families, 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, all exit 0 (including `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:nul-bytes`).
- `eslint` over the touched packages' changed paths (`pnpm lint` spelling, scoped): exit 0.
